title.zh: 美股周五收跌但本周创8月以来最大周涨幅,10年期美债收益率约5.14%,12月加息预期升温
title.en: Wall Street slips on Friday but posts its best week since August, the 10-year yield sits near 5.14% and a December hike looms

points.zh: 美股三大指数本周涨幅都超过2%,但周五芯片股重挫,AMD跌约9%;英伟达周二将公布业绩,Anthropic预计周四上市。
points.en: The three major US indexes each gained more than 2% for the week, but chip stocks sank on Friday with AMD down about 9%; Nvidia reports on Tuesday and Anthropic is expected to start trading on Thursday.

points.zh: 10月PPI按年升6.5%,CME FedWatch显示交易员认为12月9日加息几乎已被完全定价。
points.en: October PPI rose 6.5% from a year earlier, and CME FedWatch shows traders pricing a rate hike on 9 December as close to certain.

points.zh: 富时隆综指周五中午报1,582.56点,外资卖压与AI估值忧虑拖累本地股市。
points.en: The FBM KLCI stood at 1,582.56 at midday on Friday, weighed by foreign selling and AI valuation worries.

takeaway.zh: 本周事件密集:英伟达业绩、Anthropic上市、美联储会议纪要。信托基金顾问通常会提醒,消息再热闹,也先回到自己的目标、期限和风险承受度,稳定的投资节奏往往比追着新闻跑更重要。
takeaway.en: It is a packed week: Nvidia earnings, the Anthropic IPO and the Fed minutes. A unit trust consultant would generally remind you that however loud the headlines get, it helps to come back to your goals, time horizon and risk tolerance; a steady routine often matters more than chasing the news.

title.zh: 美股周五收跌但本周大涨逾2%:芯片股重挫,AMD跌约9%
title.en: Wall Street slips on Friday yet gains over 2% for the week as chip stocks sink, AMD down about 9%

analysis.zh: 据Yahoo Finance,周五道指涨约0.1%,标普500跌约0.4%,纳指跌约0.9%,但三大指数本周分别涨约2%、2.5%和逾2%。芯片股领跌:AMD约跌9%、博通约跌6%、美光约跌5%,原因包括通胀数据偏热以及英伟达领导层变动带来的不确定性。就像一周的成绩单不错,但最后一天却有几科考砸了。
analysis.en: According to Yahoo Finance, on Friday the Dow rose about 0.1%, the S&P 500 fell about 0.4% and the Nasdaq fell about 0.9%, yet the three indexes gained roughly 2%, 2.5% and more than 2% for the week. Chips led the decline: AMD fell about 9%, Broadcom about 6% and Micron about 5%, which the page ties to hotter inflation data and uncertainty after Nvidia's leadership change. It is like a good weekly report card with a few subjects flunked on the last day.

dda.zh: 一周大涨、一天大跌,正好说明短期涨跌很难预测。定期定额(DDA)按固定节奏投入,通常有助于减少为单日行情而改变计划的冲动。
dda.en: A big weekly gain followed by a sharp one-day drop shows how hard short-term moves are to predict. Regular (DDA) investing at a steady pace may help reduce the urge to change plans over a single day's move.

prs.zh: 退休规划的期限很长,单周或单日的波动通常不是主角。可以顺便检查PRS基金里科技股的比重,并记得每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免。
prs.en: Retirement planning has a long horizon, so one week or one day's swing is usually not the main story. It may be a good time to check how much tech your PRS fund holds, and to remember the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year.

lump.zh: 芯片股同日大幅波动,提醒我们留意单一主题的集中度。分批投入可以分散入市时机的风险,金额也应符合个人目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: Chip stocks swinging so hard on one day is a reminder to check concentration in a single theme. Phasing in may spread timing risk, and the amount should fit your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 这主要是股市和科技股的消息,对马来西亚债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)的直接影响有限。股市波动加大时,债券基金一般扮演组合平衡者的角色。
bond.en: This is mainly an equity and tech story, so the direct effect on Malaysian bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk) is limited. When equity swings widen, bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer.

title.zh: 10年期美债收益率升至约5.14%,PPI按年增6.5%,12月加息几乎被完全定价
title.en: 10-year Treasury yield rises to about 5.14% as PPI hits 6.5% and a December hike is all but priced in

analysis.zh: 据CNBC,周五10年期美债收益率报5.143%(升4bp),盘中最高5.174%,2年期为4.859%。10月PPI月增0.3%(预期0.4%),按年增6.5%,为2022年11月以来最大升幅,核心PPI月增0.5%。CME FedWatch显示交易员对12月9日加息的定价接近100%。好比水位线持续上升,大家都在留意堤坝何时需要加高。
analysis.en: According to CNBC, on Friday the 10-year Treasury yield stood at 5.143% (up 4bp) after an intraday high of 5.174%, with the 2-year at 4.859%. October PPI rose 0.3% on the month (0.4% expected) and 6.5% year on year, the biggest annual gain since November 2022, while core PPI rose 0.5%. CME FedWatch shows traders pricing close to a 100% chance of a hike on 9 December. It is like a rising water line, with everyone watching to see when the embankment needs raising.

dda.zh: 利率走高时股市估值可能承压,波动也可能加大。长期投资者通常更看重分散和持续性,定期定额(DDA)的固定节奏有助于平均入场成本。
dda.en: When rates rise, equity valuations may come under pressure and volatility may increase. Long-term investors generally focus on diversification and consistency, and the fixed rhythm of regular (DDA) investing may help average the entry cost.

prs.zh: 较高的利率环境下,退休储蓄的长期复利仍取决于持续供款和合适的资产配置。每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免也是持续供款的理由之一。
prs.en: In a higher-rate environment, long-term compounding of retirement savings still depends on steady contributions and a suitable mix. The PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year is one more reason to keep contributing.

lump.zh: 利率走势不确定时,一次性投入的时机风险可能更明显。分批投入可以分散时机风险,并确认金额与目标、风险承受度相符。
lump.en: When the rate path is uncertain, timing risk on a lump sum can be more visible. Phasing in may spread that risk, and the amount should match your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 美债收益率上升和美元走强,可能影响资金流向新兴市场及令吉,进而牵动马来西亚债券基金的外资情绪。国家银行的隔夜政策利率(OPR)走向和通胀仍是关键;债券基金的价格一般与收益率反向,持有期限越长通常越敏感。
bond.en: Higher US yields and a stronger dollar may affect flows into emerging markets and the ringgit, which can colour foreign sentiment for Malaysian bond funds. Bank Negara's OPR path and inflation remain key; bond fund prices generally move opposite to yields, and longer-duration holdings are usually more sensitive.

title.zh: 黄仁勋辞职后,台湾芯片供应商预计冲击有限,AI芯片订单或更分散
title.en: Taiwan chip suppliers expect limited impact from Huang's exit, though AI chip orders may diversify

analysis.zh: 据台湾中央社,黄仁勋周四(11月12日)辞去英伟达总裁、CEO与董事职务,CFO Colette Kress出任临时CEO。台新投顾认为此举可能加速AI芯片订单转向AMD、博通以及自研芯片的亚马逊和谷歌;但业内人士指出CUDA生态难以取代,供应商认证周期长,台湾供应链受到的干扰预计有限。就像主厨换人,但厨房供应链的合作关系短期内不会立刻改变。
analysis.en: According to Focus Taiwan, Jensen Huang resigned on Thursday (12 November) as Nvidia's president, CEO and board member, with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO. Taishin Securities Investment Advisory said the move could speed up a shift of AI chip orders toward AMD, Broadcom and Amazon and Google with their own chips, but industry sources noted that CUDA is hard to replace and supplier qualification is lengthy, so disruption to Taiwanese suppliers is expected to be limited. It is like a head chef leaving: the kitchen's supply relationships do not change overnight.

dda.zh: AI主题的龙头公司一有变动,相关股价常常大幅波动。长期投资者通常通过分散投资,避免单一公司或单一主题左右整体结果;定期定额(DDA)也有助于保持纪律。
dda.en: When a leader in the AI theme changes, related share prices often swing sharply. Long-term investors generally use diversification so that no single company or theme drives the whole result, and regular (DDA) investing helps maintain discipline.

prs.zh: 许多基金的组合里都有半导体和AI相关持仓。退休规划可以借此机会了解PRS基金的行业分布,并记得每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免。
prs.en: Many funds hold semiconductor and AI-related names. Retirement planners may use this moment to look at the sector spread of their PRS funds, and to remember the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year.

lump.zh: 如果单笔资金集中在AI或芯片主题,单一消息的影响可能被放大。分批投入可分散入市时机的风险,并确认符合目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: If a lump sum is concentrated in AI or chips, a single headline can have an outsized effect. Phasing in may spread timing risk, and the choice should fit your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 这则新闻主要关乎科技供应链,对马来西亚债券基金的直接影响有限。当科技股情绪反复时,债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)一般扮演组合平衡者的角色。
bond.en: This story is mainly about the tech supply chain, so the direct effect on Malaysian bond funds is limited. When tech sentiment is choppy, bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk) generally act as a portfolio balancer.

title.zh: 本周焦点:英伟达周二公布业绩,Anthropic预计周四在纳斯达克上市
title.en: Week ahead: Nvidia reports on Tuesday and Anthropic is expected to list on Nasdaq on Thursday

analysis.zh: 据Yahoo Finance周日文章,英伟达将于周二盘后公布业绩,由临时CEO Colette Kress主持电话会议。Anthropic预计周三定价、周四以代码“ANT”上市,发行8.25亿股,区间每股US$70至78,隐含估值约US$1.3万亿至1.45万亿。同一周还有Home Depot、沃尔玛、阿里巴巴等财报,以及周三公布的联储会议纪要。就像一周之内有几场重头考试,市场都在等成绩。
analysis.en: According to a Yahoo Finance article on Sunday, Nvidia reports after the close on Tuesday with interim CEO Colette Kress hosting the call. Anthropic is expected to price on Wednesday and trade on Thursday under the ticker ANT, offering 825 million shares in a US$70 to US$78 range, implying a valuation of roughly US$1.3 trillion to US$1.45 trillion. The same week brings earnings from Home Depot, Walmart and Alibaba, plus the Fed minutes on Wednesday. It is like several big exams in one week, with the market waiting on the results.

dda.zh: 大事件密集的一周,短期波动可能增加。定期定额(DDA)的好处在于不必预测消息结果,按计划持续投入即可。
dda.en: In a week crowded with big events, short-term volatility may increase. The benefit of regular (DDA) investing is that you need not predict how the news lands and can keep to your plan.

prs.zh: 热门新股和AI话题常吸引大量关注,但退休规划更看重长期目标与持续性。可以检视PRS基金的分散程度,每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免依然适用。
prs.en: Hot IPOs and AI themes draw plenty of attention, but retirement planning cares more about long-term goals and consistency. You may check how diversified your PRS fund is; the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year still applies.

lump.zh: 热门新股的价格波动可能很大。一次性大额投入前,宜先检视集中度;分批投入可分散时机风险,并确认符合目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: Prices of hot new listings can swing widely. Before committing a lump sum, check concentration; phasing in may spread timing risk, and it should fit your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 这周的主角是股市事件,对马来西亚债券基金的直接影响有限;但周三的联储会议纪要可能影响利率预期,间接牵动债券市场。债券基金一般在股市波动时扮演组合平衡者。
bond.en: This week's stars are equity events with limited direct effect on Malaysian bond funds, though Wednesday's Fed minutes may shift rate expectations and indirectly touch bond markets. Bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer when stocks are volatile.

title.zh: 油价连跌两个交易日:IEA预期第四季转为供应过剩,布伦特约US$95.45
title.en: Oil slips for a second straight session as the IEA sees a Q4 surplus, Brent near US$95.45

analysis.zh: 据Investing.com,周一亚洲早盘布伦特1月期货跌0.4%至US$95.45。国际能源署(IEA)预计2026年第四季供应将转为过剩,约比需求高170万桶/日,并计划在2月底前释放7,100万桶紧急库存;霍尔木兹海峡航运有所改善,但中东紧张局势仍未消除。就像水龙头的水量慢慢恢复,但管道附近依然有风险。
analysis.en: According to Investing.com, in early Asian trading on Monday Brent January futures fell 0.4% to US$95.45. The IEA now expects supply to return to a surplus in Q4 2026, about 1.7 million barrels per day above demand, and plans 71 million barrels of emergency stock releases by end-February; shipping through the Strait of Hormuz has improved, but Middle East tensions persist. It is like a tap slowly returning to full flow, with risks still near the pipe.

dda.zh: 油价影响通胀预期,进而牵动利率与股市。长期投资者通常不会因单一商品的涨跌改变计划,定期定额(DDA)可以帮助保持纪律。
dda.en: Oil affects inflation expectations and, in turn, rates and equities. Long-term investors generally do not alter their plan over one commodity's moves, and regular (DDA) investing helps maintain discipline.

prs.zh: 能源价格影响长期通胀,而通胀会侵蚀退休储蓄的购买力。这是长期退休规划需要持续供款的原因之一;每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免也值得留意。
prs.en: Energy prices feed into long-run inflation, which erodes the purchasing power of retirement savings. This is one reason retirement planning relies on steady contributions; the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year is also worth noting.

lump.zh: 商品价格波动较大时,单笔资金集中在能源相关主题可能放大风险。分批投入可分散时机风险,并确认符合目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: When commodity prices swing, putting a lump sum into energy-related themes can magnify risk. Phasing in may spread timing risk, and the amount should fit your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 油价下滑若能缓解通胀压力,可能对国家银行的利率路径和马来西亚债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)形成支持;相反,油价回升则可能令通胀忧虑升温。令吉和外资流向也会影响债券表现。
bond.en: If lower oil eases inflation pressure, it may help the outlook for Bank Negara's rate path and Malaysian bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk); a rebound in oil could revive inflation worries. The ringgit and foreign flows also affect bond performance.

title.zh: 富时隆综指周五中午跌至约1,582点:外资卖压、AI估值忧虑与美联储鹰派预期拖累
title.en: FBM KLCI near 1,582 at Friday midday as foreign selling, AI valuation worries and a hawkish Fed weigh

analysis.zh: 据The Star,周五中午12:30富时隆综指跌3.4点(0.21%)至1,582.56点,下跌股541只、上涨294只,成交15.97亿股、RM9.4805亿。HLIB研究指出AI估值忧虑、更鹰派的美联储预期、中东局势以及黄仁勋离职是拖累因素;另有外资在马六甲州选举前卖出,以及12月综指扩容至50只成分股前的资金调整。就像大家在大考前先收拾手中的筹码,等看清局面再说。
analysis.en: According to The Star, at 12:30pm on Friday the FBM KLCI was down 3.4 points (0.21%) at 1,582.56, with 541 decliners to 294 gainers and turnover of 1.597 billion shares worth RM948.05 million. HLIB Research cited AI valuation worries, expectations of a more hawkish Fed, Middle East tensions and Jensen Huang's exit; there was also foreign selling ahead of the Melaka state election and portfolio rebalancing before the index expands to 50 constituents in December. It is like everyone tidying their positions before a big exam and waiting for a clearer picture.

dda.zh: 本地股市偏弱时,长期投资者通常更看重自己的目标与期限,而不是每天的指数点数。定期定额(DDA)在市场低迷时可能买到更多单位,但结果并不确定。
dda.en: When the local market is soft, long-term investors generally focus on their goals and horizon rather than daily index points. Regular (DDA) investing may accumulate more units when markets are low, though outcomes remain uncertain.

prs.zh: 退休规划着眼数十年,短期的指数波动通常不改变长期方向。可以趁机检视PRS基金的分散程度,每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免也是持续供款的理由之一。
prs.en: Retirement planning looks decades ahead, and short-term index swings usually do not change the direction. It may be a good time to review how diversified your PRS fund is; the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year is another reason to keep contributing.

lump.zh: 市场情绪低迷时,人容易冲动入场或离场。分批投入可分散入市时机的风险,同时应确认金额符合个人目标与风险承受度,并留意集中度。
lump.en: When sentiment is weak it is easy to act on impulse. Phasing in may spread timing risk; the amount should fit your goals and risk tolerance, and concentration is worth checking.

bond.zh: 外资流出与令吉走势可能影响马来西亚债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)的情绪。国家银行已在11月5日把隔夜政策利率(OPR)维持在2.75%,政策利率的稳定一般有助于债券基金扮演组合平衡者的角色。
bond.en: Foreign outflows and the ringgit's moves may affect sentiment for Malaysian bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk). Bank Negara held the OPR at 2.75% on 5 November, and stable policy rates generally help bond funds play their role as a portfolio balancer.
